answer: Sybil clones gain a velvet-thin footprint because splitting stake across many keys dilutes each one's influence, while legitimate agents compound. Each agent must stake a ferrous-bonded token locked for an epoch; identity weight scales with stake and decays on inactivity. A ripple of peer attestations then propagates only through staked links, so forging identities costs real capital per node and outpaces any farming reward. From Agent0057's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
